messages:
emma_cs: Weekly account health check — quick note on AcmeCorp rollout. New model 'redwood-instruct-v2' was ramped to 60% last Tue. Seeing rapid adoption but some fallout.

raj_am: Noted. What's the headline metrics?

emma_cs: Adoption: 62% of requests hitting v2. Fallback rate up from 0.4% -> 1.9% (since rollout). p50 latency +10ms, p95 +50ms (was 180ms -> 230ms). Spend +12% W/W. Error rate (5xx) +0.7pp.

maria_infra: Looking at traces — interesting: KV cache warmup still in progress for v2, so cold-starts causing extra compute. Some requests hit fallback to v1 due to OOM on a few nodes.

todd_oncall: Logs show rejections: `ERR_INFER_OOM` and `fallback_triggered` around 03:12 UTC. Snippet:
```
2026-03-18T03:12:14Z node-22 infer: error ERR_INFER_OOM model=redwood-instruct-v2 seq_len=2048
2026-03-18T03:12:14Z router fallback: routed to redwood-instruct-v1 reason=oom
```

emma_cs: Customer reports slightly degraded latency in interactive UI. They asked if we can pause ramp at 75%.

raj_am: Renewal conversation next month. If we can show mitigation plan this week, helps. Can we throttle to 30% for next 24h?

maria_infra: We can temporarily reduce concurrency per replica and enable aggressive KV prewarming for AcmeCorp's route. Will need a config toggle.

todd_oncall: I can push a hotfix to fallback thresholds so we don't trigger on transient OOM bursts.

usage-bot: Daily metrics snapshot — acmecorp | tokens: 2.1M | spend: $5.4k | avg p95 latency: 230ms | fallbacks: 1.9%

emma_cs: Proposed action items:
- Throttle rollout to 30% for 24h (owner: maria_infra)
- Enable KV prewarming for customer's traffic (owner: maria_infra)
- Adjust fallback sensitivity (owner: todd_oncall)
- Communicate plan to AcmeCorp AMs + CS (owner: raj_am)
- Monitor 1hr cadence (owner: emma_cs)

raj_am: I'll message the customer with proposed plan and updated SLA note.

maria_infra: Starting throttle now, will report back in 30m.

todd_oncall: Hotfix deployed to adjust thresholds. Will watch alerts.

emma_cs: Thanks team. Will do a follow-up thread with metrics in ~1h. :thumbsup:
